item.blurb: Scoop: Anthropic's Dario Amodei to have White House dinner with Trump. President Trump plans to host Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at a private White House dinner on Sunday evening, sources familiar told Axios.Why it matters: The dinner —the first one-on-one meeting between the two— is an indication of thawing relations between Anthropic and the administration, whose officials and allies have had longstanding tensions.Driving the news:  Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson plan to meet top  AI CEOs
